//prettier: Pinned exactly, no caret. A formatter version is not a library version: 3.9.x reformats html` template literals differently from 3.4.x, so a range made the same commit pass on a laptop and fail in CI, on one file, for reasons visible only in the job log. Pinning the version is the fix; a caret on a formatter trades a green build for a diff nobody asked for.
